steps.text: Each player: rooster above the wake-up chart, cork on the start of the victory point track, wine bottle on the middle of the Residual Payment Tracker
Shuffle the 4 small card decks (green, yellow, purple, blue) onto the board
Each player: a vineyard mat with the 3 field cards (5, 6 and 7 lira) side by side, field side up
Draw a random rooster: that player is first and takes the first player token
Shuffle the mama and papa cards; deal one of each faceup to each player
steps.note: Variant: draw 2 of each and choose 1

steps.text: Mama: 2 regular workers and the cards she shows as your opening hand
Papa: 1 grande worker and his lira; in clockwise order choose his structure or the extra lira
Discard the mama and papa cards
You can't drop below -5 victory points
Spring: from the first player, each places their rooster on the wake-up chart
